news_risk: No sanctions, regulator action or negative news found. Note: the company's own website (vinodmedical.com) displays a placeholder CIN '123434456456456', which is not a valid CIN format — a data-quality/credibility flag on the site, not a risk event. Searches for sanctions/Russia exposure returned no results; the search backend was partly unavailable (DuckDuckGo/Google blocked or rate-limited), so absence of hits is not proof of absence.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or CIS. The only customs-related record located is a domestic Indian customs dispute (CESTAT Ahmedabad, order 08.09.2023, re: Commissioner of Customs order of 27.10.2020) — this concerns Indian import/export compliance, not Russia/CIS supply. No B/L, customs entry or contract evidencing RF/CIS shipments was found in public sources.
note: Risk-only review. Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List hit found for 'Vinod Medical Systems Pvt Ltd' in the sources reachable; sanctions-list screening was limited because the search backend failed (searx connection refused, Google 429, DuckDuckGo timeout) and zaubacorp/thecompanycheck returned 403 — treat sanctions as 'not found', not as 'cleared'. Court cases: five matters identified via Indian Kanoon, all civil/administrative — three writ petitions against Raipur Development Authority and the State of M.P. (company as petitioner, latest order 28.03.2025), one CESTAT customs appeal (order 08.09.2023), plus two ITAT transfer-pricing matters where the company is only a comparable, not a litigant. Per project rule 2 these are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally: 'есть сложности'. Credit rating: null — no rating found in public sources (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings not checked due to call budget; not public in reachable sources). Regulator actions: none found. Negative news: none found. RF/CIS supply: no evidence. Note the website's invalid placeholder CIN — do not rely on it; legal identity was out of scope for this review.
